chunks: O you who believe, have fear of displeasing God, and believe in His Prophet. He will give you twice as much of His bounty and place a light for you to walk in, and forgive you, for God is forgiving and kind;

key_terms.اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ: Have fear of displeasing God / God-consciousness

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual rewards for combining faith and God-consciousness according to Surah Al-Hadid?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of 'Kifl' (share), where the 'double mercy' is interpreted as the unique spiritual station granted to the Ahl al-Bayt and the faithful who follow their guidance. The 'light' (Nur) is frequently understood not merely as general guidance, but as the specific illumination of the Imams, serving as the practical manifestation of faith in the Prophet. This connects the theological act of belief with the practical necessity of following the divinely appointed leaders for true spiritual navigation.
